metadata.description: A markdown brain that gives your AI coding tools judgment and rigor: sharp defaults, real decisions, and the discipline to verify before saying done. For Claude Code, Cursor and Codex.

plugins.name: mastermind
plugins.description: A markdown brain that gives your AI coding tools judgment and rigor. plugins.name: mastermind-mod
plugins.description: Optional Claude Code mod for MasterMind (Claude Code 2.1.287 or newer): asks before irreversible actions, shows the brain's status, and flags answers that claim completion without a verdict. Opt-in, because it runs code inside Claude Code; read mod/README.md first. Experimental (v0.33.2).
